name: omega-closure-ethics
description: A portable Closure Ethics guardrail for ChatGPT and Codex that adds a reusable decision skill, pre-action review hooks, and Omega Sentinel-style local audit receipts.

interface.shortDescription: Closure-aware review and audit for consequential agent actions.
interface.longDescription: Adds a portable Closure Ethics workflow to ChatGPT and Codex. The plugin separates task optimization from admissibility review, flags consequential actions for human review, hard-blocks recognizable guardrail/audit tampering patterns, and writes local Omega Sentinel-style decision receipts when plugin hooks are supported and trusted.
defaultPrompt: Use Omega Closure Ethics to review this plan before taking consequential actions.
Evaluate this operation for authorization, auditability, repairability, reversibility, and uncertainty.
Use the Closure Critic to identify whether this action should be allowed, modified, escalated for human review, or denied.
